_comment: Opinion layer — backing_type taxonomy, trust tier, editorial one-liners. Slugs match DefiLlama pool `project` field. pool_project / pool_projects map to different DefiLlama slugs when they diverge.

blackrock-buidl.name: BlackRock BUIDL
blackrock-buidl.one_liner: BlackRock's tokenized US Treasury fund. Daily redemptions, SEC-registered, Securitize as transfer agent.

circle-usyc.name: Hashnote USYC
circle-usyc.one_liner: Short-duration US Treasury fund via Hashnote. Institutional-grade, regulated wrapper, now under Circle.

ondo-yield-assets.name: Ondo USDY / OUSG
ondo-yield-assets.one_liner: Ondo's US Treasury-backed yield tokens. USDY is permissionless on supported chains; OUSG is permissioned. Daily redemptions.

invesco-ustb.name: Invesco USTB
invesco-ustb.one_liner: Invesco's tokenized short-term Treasury bond ETF. Institutional pedigree, Securitize-distributed.

openeden-tbill.name: OpenEden TBILL
openeden-tbill.one_liner: Tokenized US T-bill vault. Known issuer, regulated but BVI-domiciled — one notch below US-regulated wrappers.

centrifuge.name: Centrifuge
centrifuge.one_liner: Real-world credit pools on-chain — invoices, trade finance, structured credit. Epoch-based redemptions; counterparty risk on each pool.

maple.name: Maple Finance
maple.tier_overrides: DefiLlama tags as 'Lending' — reclassified as private-credit because loans go to institutional borrowers (real-world credit), not on-chain collateralised lending.
maple.one_liner: Institutional lending to real-world borrowers. Previously had defaults (2022); v2 restructured with better underwriting. Still private credit risk.

securitize.name: Securitize Funds
securitize.one_liner: Tokenized credit funds — Apollo CLO, Hamilton Lane senior credit. Institutional managers, Securitize as platform. Accredited investors only.

huma-finance-v2.name: Huma Finance
huma-finance-v2.one_liner: Payment financing and receivables on Solana. Newer protocol, growing TVL but limited track record. Private credit risk.

midas-rwa.name: Midas RWA
midas-rwa.one_liner: Euro and USD Treasury-backed tokens. EU-regulated issuer, multiple backing strategies including T-bills and basis yield.

ethena.name: Ethena USDe / sUSDe
ethena.tier_overrides: USDtb is partially backed by BUIDL, but the yield mechanism is synthetic (funding rate arbitrage). The delta-neutral basis trade is NOT a real-world asset — stays tier 4.
ethena.one_liner: Delta-neutral basis trade — earns funding rates, NOT backed by real-world assets. Often appears in RWA listings but is a synthetic yield product.

ethena-usdtb.name: Ethena USDtb
ethena-usdtb.tier_overrides: Partially backed by BUIDL (BlackRock), but yield comes from the same basis-trade mechanism as USDe. The BUIDL backing does not make this an RWA — the yield source is synthetic.
ethena-usdtb.one_liner: Marketed as 'institutional USDe' with BUIDL backing, but yield is still from basis trades. Not a real-world asset despite the packaging.

usual-usd0.name: Usual USD0
usual-usd0.tier_overrides: Backed by T-bills but through a novel protocol structure with governance token. Less established than tier-1 issuers.
usual-usd0.one_liner: Treasury-backed stablecoin with yield redistribution via USUAL governance token. T-bill backing is real, but protocol structure is newer.

stusdt.name: stUSDT
stusdt.tier_overrides: Claims T-bill backing but opaque structure, tied to Justin Sun ecosystem. Auditing and transparency significantly below tier-1/2 standards.
stusdt.one_liner: Claims US Treasury backing but opaque issuer structure. Proceed with caution — transparency far below institutional standards.

mountain-protocol.name: Mountain USDM
mountain-protocol.one_liner: Rebasing yield-bearing stablecoin backed by short-term US Treasuries. Bermuda-regulated, daily NAV updates.

re.name: Re (reUSD)
re.one_liner: Reinsurance-backed yield protocol. Novel backing type (reinsurance premiums). Limited track record, higher risk.

realt-tokens.name: RealT
realt-tokens.one_liner: Tokenized US rental properties. Each token is a share in an LLC holding a single property. Rental yield distributed weekly.

lofty.name: Lofty
lofty.one_liner: Fractional US rental real estate. Similar model to RealT but on Algorand. Rental income distributed to token holders.

ondo-global-markets.name: Ondo Global Markets
ondo-global-markets.one_liner: Tokenized US equities — TSLA, NVDA, etc. on-chain. Not a yield product; equity exposure only.
